The one in the photo: stainless steel (steel case, black leather strap), silver dial, day/month windows, moonphase, date pointer with outer date track, Arabic numerals. That's the Fiftysix Complete Calendar in steel — ref 4000E/000A-B439.

Movement: automatic, caliber 2460 QCL/1. Case material: stainless steel. Bracelet: leather (alligator).

Model family: Fiftysix Complete Calendar (Fiftysix collection). Let me verify reference format: "4000E/000A-B439". Yes.
